summary: Implemented an inert ecosystem artifact staging store with digest-bound verification and staging reports.
acceptance_evidence: agent_core::ecosystem::ArtifactStagingStore stages resolved artifacts under a staging root and writes payload, verification report and staging report files.
Staging reports are explicitly inert and activation_prepared=false.
Staging refuses active-state target paths before writing artifacts.
Digest mismatches fail closed before staging output is written.
Missing optional features are recorded as degraded optional features without host mutation.

commands.summary: Functional capability replay passed and wrote .workflow/artifacts/functional-replay/result.json.
agent_core 103, agentd 56, runtime_contracts 20 and security_execution 75 tests passed, plus doc tests.

blocked_shortcuts: Staging does not mutate active artifact state.
Staging does not bypass AgentCore PlanSpec or SecurityExecutionEngine.
Digest mismatches are errors, not warnings.
Optional dependency degradation does not authorize host mutation.
promotion_impact: Enables local aom verify/stage/explain flows to operate on inert staged artifacts before runtime-mediated activation is implemented.
